business_summary: Deep Polymers Limited manufactures and sells filler masterbatches in India. The company offers white, black, color, and UV, as well as additive masterbatches, including antiblock, antifog, antimicrobial/bactiblock additive, antioxidant, antirodent, antistatic, desiccant, flame retardant, nucleating and clarifying agent, optical brightener, oxo biodegradable, PPA, and slip masterbatches. It also provides antifab fillers, such as calcium filler PP/PE, calcium filler PP/PE  lamination, super brightener filler, coloured tinge filler, natural filler  TPFN 001, and process modifier. In addition, the company offers non-woven, PP multifilament, and biodegradable master batches. Its products are used in HDPE; PP; LDPE; LLDPE; FBLK007- black tone; PPCP; PS; HIPS; blown film/cast film/mono layer/multi layer; pipes; automotive compound PE/PP/glass filled; engineering compound PC/ABS/nylon; antifab filler PP/PE; ABS; SAN; PP/PE tape extrusion; PP/PE lamination; PP/PE injection and blow moulding; PP box strapping; PP/PE calendaring process; PP non-woven; bio-degradable oxo/compostible; PET optical fiber; PET bottle; polyester sheet; and engineering masterbatch PC/ABS/PBT/nylon/PET applications. Deep Polymers Limited was founded in 1992 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.
